notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE! ONE MAP – Ranked System, UI Overhaul, & Ammo System Now Live
notes.content:
[p][b]MAJOR UPDATE: ONE MAP – Never Ending Battle Royale[/b]
[/p][p]Enjoy the latest updates and improvements:
[/p][p]- Completely Redesigned UI: Brand new look for menus, HUD, and all screens.[/p][p]- Player Rating System: See how you stack up against other players with skill based badges, MMR rating/ranking system, and visible progress indicators.[/p][p]- Interactive Pre Game Lobby: Hangout in an apartment overlooking the game map for the pre game lobby.[/p][p]- Leaderboard Upgrade: More detailed, competitive, and easier to read rankings.[/p][p]- Live Top 7 Tracker: Instantly view the top players during a match.[/p][p]- Map Collider Overhaul: Better alignment between physical objects and their hitboxes.[/p][p]- New Gun Scroll Toggle: Use your mouse to scroll and switch weapons faster.[/p][p]- Invert Look Option: Now you can invert both X and Y axis for a personalized aiming experience.[/p][p]- Ammo System Added: No more unlimited ammo/grenades, instead find ammo boxes on the map.[/p][p]- Performance Boost: Optimized code for smoother gameplay on all devices.[/p][p]- Bug Fixes: Addressed multiple issues across UI, gameplay, glitches, and more.[/p][p]- Crash Fixes: Improved stability for better, uninterrupted matches.[/p][p]- Better Controller Support: Improved controller toggles to better navigate the UI and gameplay.[/p][p]- Design & Visual Enhancements: Cleaned up visuals and UX across menus and gameplay. Also, fixed the shadow issue that was happening.[/p][p]- FPS Improvements: Increased frame rate stability for more intense matches.
[/p][p]Thank you for playing ONE MAP! We’re constantly updating and improving the game to ensure the best possible experience. Enjoy the game![/p]

tags.feature: - Completely Redesigned UI: Brand new look for menus, HUD, and all screens.
- Player Rating System: See how you stack up against other players with skill based badges, MMR rating/ranking system, and visible progress indicators.
- Interactive Pre Game Lobby: Hangout in an apartment overlooking the game map for the pre game lobby.
- Leaderboard Upgrade: More detailed, competitive, and easier to read rankings.
- Live Top 7 Tracker: Instantly view the top players during a match.

tags.bug: - Map Collider Overhaul: Better alignment between physical objects and their hitboxes.

tags.feature: - New Gun Scroll Toggle: Use your mouse to scroll and switch weapons faster.
- Invert Look Option: Now you can invert both X and Y axis for a personalized aiming experience.
- Ammo System Added: No more unlimited ammo/grenades, instead find ammo boxes on the map.
- Performance Boost: Optimized code for smoother gameplay on all devices.

tags.bug: - Bug Fixes: Addressed multiple issues across UI, gameplay, glitches, and more.
- Crash Fixes: Improved stability for better, uninterrupted matches.

tags.feature: - Better Controller Support: Improved controller toggles to better navigate the UI and gameplay.
- Design & Visual Enhancements: Cleaned up visuals and UX across menus and gameplay. Also, fixed the shadow issue that was happening.
- FPS Improvements: Increased frame rate stability for more intense matches.

notes.title: Patch Notes May 2, 2025
notes.content:
Thank you everyone for playing One Map and providing us with a lot of feedback on how to make the game better. In this update we were able to make major improvements to performance, fix design issues and include new features that will allow for more dynamic gameplay:

[list]
[*] Hit Detection Solved: Improved accuracy for detecting hits during gameplay
[*] Climbing Added: Players can now climb obstacles to reach new areas
[*] Hit Box Improved: Better alignment for more consistent shot registration
[*] Design Fixes: Multiple visual and UI improvements throughout the game
[*] Controller Support Enhanced: Improved aim assist, smoother sensitivity, and overall better controller responsiveness
[*] Bug fixes and other performance improvements
[/list]

We are really excited for everyone to try this new update and if you find any bugs or have any ideas on how we can continue to improve One Map, please join our Discord and let us know! We are already working on the next major update so we would love additional ideas to add!

notes.title: Patch Notes April 1, 2025
notes.content:
Thank you everyone for the support we received already for One Map! We appreciate all the positive feedback, suggestions and bug fixes. Thanks to the steam community we were able to fix bugs in the game that we did not notice. If anyone ever finds any more issues, please put it on the discussion board or join our discord which there is a link to on One Map's main menu. Here is a list of what has been fixed in todays update:

[list]
[*] Username issue that was preventing players from joining the game due to an empty character in the username. For example, the username "Test 123" did not load into the game while "Test123" did load into the game. Now usernames should be able to have spaces without any problems (please let us know otherwise)
[*] There was a multiple character skins overlapping bug that was happening on the first game that merged all the character skins together as one character. This is fixed now and a player also mentioned an invisible character in the game, and we think this was a similar bug which should be fixed now as well
[*] Some users were experiencing loading issues going to the main menu, this is now fixed too! (If this continues to happen to anyone please let us know)
[*] A few minor UI fixes. The arrows in the character selection page were modified so that players understand when they are on the first or last character in the list
[/list]

Thank you again everyone and we look forward to playing One Map with you soon!
